Name: Dorking Library
Short_Description: Surrey County Council's public library in St Martin's Walk, Dorking. It has automatic doors, a hearing loop, and a RADAR-key disabled toilet in the children's area (the council page says that toilet is unavailable during Super Access hours). Baby-changing is not mentioned on the official library page, so it is not listed on the baby-changing layer.
When: Staffed hours: Monday, Wednesday and Friday 9:30am–5:30pm; Tuesday and Thursday 9:30am–7pm; Saturday 9:30am–5pm. Closed on Sundays and bank holidays. Super Access offers extended hours outside staffed times. Pay-and-display parking is at the rear of St Martin's Walk.
Booking_Note: A Surrey library card is used for borrowing; the official page has opening and Super Access details.
Verify_Note: Official Surrey County Council library page, 22 November 2026. This is the only public library in the trimmed map area; Bookham and Leatherhead libraries sit outside it. Days are the staffed days; Sunday is closed and was not added to the What's on column. The children's-area toilet is described as a RADAR-key disabled toilet, not as a baby-changing room.
